risk_note: RV2 by path (payment). Pay order close and expiry (BR-PAY-05 ①, BR-PAY-02, BR-PAY-03): runOrderClose re-reads the order inside the business-object lock by app_id + pay_order_id; at expire_at it sets closing through the generated CAS (close_reason expired); an order never placed (launch_issued_at null and no pay_query_attempts) goes straight to PO3 in the same transaction; otherwise it queries first and closes outside the lock — a paid answer goes to B2-15c's judgement (PO2), «not found» closes (PO3) only after expire_at + grace; every query / close writes its attempt row; a pending order re-enqueues itself on the expire_at + k×retry grid (cancel and expiry chains merge into one singletonKey) and becomes needs_manual with a warn at expire_at + wait. order.close in jobs/pay-jobs.ts now routes to runOrderClose. Late success notifications after a close keep B2-15c's anomaly path. Time only from the injected Clock. No contract or schema change, no migration. Taken over by admin-backend from the pay lane (account 4 out of weekly quota until 10-30). Rule tests by an independent Claude (approvals #36), red before the implementation; implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent in one run.
